graph_source: V1 automatic partial STSG; no human graph repair
selection: generate full syntactic candidate pool including abstentions; exact-question dedup; fixed SHA256(seed+question_id) rank in each type, max8 each, no outcome/answer-quality filtering or replacement to meet24
entity_binding: unique accepted class label at source frame only; otherwise abstain; no ordinal-only disambiguation, no referent text containing answer
multi_attribute_values: abstain on conflicting literal values for same entity/type/time
relation_answers: all accepted literal predicates for the same source-frame endpoints; preserve strings; no synonym rewrite
identity: native one-to-one accepted STATIC_MERGED or REFERENCE_CREATED links only; graph missing edge is NOT proof of different identity; negative/unresolved pairs become abstaining diagnostics
motion: respect usable_for_program_QA=false; before-motion candidate tests abstain DEPENDENCY_UNSUPPORTED; never turn protection off
temporal_counts: time-anchored color/material questions are static; cross-frame identity separate from action/order reasoning
question_freeze: qid/video/source times/text/program/version/candidate answer/dependencies/content hashes frozen before Base model calls; separate public blind question file omits answers and dependencies

base_solver.kind: unadapted Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, not Video-Zero v4 or evolved checkpoint
base_solver.input_rule: deterministic temporal coverage from existing frozen source-frame pool, no source-video replacement; freeze PNG/hash/PTS first; fewer than32 available retained with denominator
base_solver.instruction: answer the question directly from video; no graph, program, candidate answer or human labels supplied

human_evaluation: PENDING; no formal B0/B1/B2 claims; no difficulty or accuracy labels before independent answers
